# robinhood-chain-alerts

> Telegram + Discord alert bots for Robinhood Chain memecoins: new launches, graduations, whale trades. Hosted service, free + premium tier.

robinhood-chain-alerts is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs
